title: Ssl.RAND_pseudo_bytes has been removed
summary: Python 3.12 removed ssl.RAND_pseudo_bytes, so using it raises an error.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of ssl.RAND_pseudo_bytes with os.urandom() or ssl.RAND_bytes().

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
